usefulness.rationale: The dossier correctly identifies Hilary Cottam as a social entrepreneur and author of Radical Help, and its three claims are each directly supported by the cited RSA talk page quote. However, the dossier is very thin: it rests on a single source (an RSA Replay event page, largely promotional copy), and omits key identity anchors such as founding Participle or being named UK Designer of the Year, even though a retained source (her own site) hints at this. A reader learns who she is and her core thesis but little about what she actually did. No explicit gaps or unknowns are stated, so it implies more completeness than it has. The listed unjustified conclusions (agency-outcomes, participle-solo) do not appear anywhere in the dossier, so no overclaims can be matched to them. The dossier's claims themselves stay within their citations; 'internationally acclaimed' is promotional language but is quoted as a description, not asserted as independent fact.
